children.label: Find missing order confirmation
children.answer_text: Check your spam folder and allow up to 15 minutes. The order confirmation is sent to the email address entered at checkout. If you saved the order number shown after checkout, use Order Lookup with that number and the checkout email. If you still cannot locate the order, contact support before placing it again so we can help you avoid a duplicate order.

children.label: Cancel my order
children.answer_text: You can cancel from Order Lookup or your account within 30 minutes of placing the order, provided it has not entered packing. Select Manage Order and then Cancel Order. If the button is no longer available, cancellation is no longer possible. After delivery, eligible items can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

children.label: Sort out delivery address change
children.answer_text: Open Order Lookup and select Manage Order within 30 minutes of placing the order. You can change the shipping address only while the order has not entered packing. If the address cannot be edited, contact support promptly. A change cannot be guaranteed once packing starts, and we cannot redirect a parcel after dispatch.

children.label: Sort out wrong size, color or items
children.answer_text: Items, sizes, and colors cannot be edited after an order is placed. If the order is less than 30 minutes old and has not entered packing, cancel it through Manage Order and place a new order with the correct items. If it is already being packed, keep the order and request an eligible return or exchange after delivery.

children.label: Sort out missed promo code
children.answer_text: A promotion code cannot be added after checkout. If your order is still within the 30-minute cancellation window and has not entered packing, you can cancel and place it again using the code. Otherwise, the price paid remains unchanged. Promotions cannot be combined, and final-sale items and gift cards are excluded from promotion codes.

children.label: Check where you deliver
children.answer_text: We deliver to residential and business street addresses in the 48 contiguous United States. We do not currently deliver to Alaska, Hawaii, US territories, military addresses, PO boxes, or international addresses. Available shipping options are shown after you enter your delivery address at checkout.

children.label: Check standard shipping cost
children.answer_text: Standard shipping costs $5.95. It is free when the merchandise subtotal is at least $75 after discounts and before tax. Gift card purchases do not count toward the $75 threshold. The shipping charge confirmed at checkout is not increased later if you return part of the order.

children.label: Check standard delivery time
children.answer_text: In-stock standard orders normally leave our warehouse within 1 to 2 business days. Standard transit then takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding US public holidays. Your dispatch confirmation includes your tracking link and the carrier's estimated delivery date.

children.label: Check express shipping cost and speed
children.answer_text: Express shipping costs $14.95, including on orders that qualify for free standard shipping. In-stock express orders placed before 2 PM Eastern Time on a business day are normally dispatched that day, later orders are normally dispatched the next business day. Express transit takes 2 business days after dispatch. Preorder items are not eligible for express delivery.

children.label: Check when preorder will ship
children.answer_text: The estimated dispatch date for a preorder appears on the product page and in your order confirmation. In-stock items ship separately without waiting for the preorder, at no additional standard shipping charge. Preorder items use standard shipping and are not eligible for express delivery. You will be emailed if the estimated dispatch date changes.

children.label: Find tracking for my parcel
children.answer_text: Check your dispatch email for a tracking link for each parcel. You can also open the order in your account or Order Lookup and select Track Parcel. Allow up to 24 hours after dispatch for tracking to show the carrier's first scan.

children.label: Report tracking with no update
children.answer_text: Allow up to 24 hours after dispatch for the first carrier scan. While the parcel is in transit, check the carrier's estimated delivery date. Contact support if there has been no new scan for 3 business days or the parcel is past the carrier's estimated delivery date. We will investigate with the carrier.

children.label: Report delivered parcel missing
children.answer_text: Check the delivery photo, your entrance or mailroom, and anyone who may have accepted the parcel. Sometimes a delivery scan appears before the parcel is physically dropped off, so allow 24 hours. If it is still missing, contact support with your order number and confirm the delivery address so we can investigate with the carrier.

children.label: Check why only part of order arrived
children.answer_text: Items in one order may be sent from different warehouses and arrive in separate parcels. Check the shipping confirmation for a tracking link for each parcel. You pay the shipping charge shown at checkout only once; there is no extra shipping fee for a split shipment. Contact support if an item listed on a packing slip is missing from that parcel, or all listed parcels have arrived and an item is still missing.

children.label: Sort out missed delivery
children.answer_text: Use the carrier's tracking page to check the next delivery attempt or available pickup options. Bring the identification requested by the carrier when collecting a parcel. If the parcel is being returned to us, contact support so we can discuss a new shipment or an eligible refund.

children.label: Sort out parcel returned to sender
children.answer_text: Contact support with your order number and the correct delivery address. Once the parcel returns to our warehouse, we can arrange a new standard shipment or refund the eligible merchandise. A new $5.95 shipping charge applies when the original address was incomplete or incorrect. If the return was caused by our error or the carrier's error, the replacement shipment is free.

children.label: Ask about late express delivery
children.answer_text: Contact support with your order number if an express parcel arrives after the carrier's confirmed delivery commitment. We will review the tracking record and the reason for the delay. If we approve a refund of the express shipping charge, we send it to the original payment method; your bank may take an additional 3 to 5 business days to display it.

children.label: Return an item for change of mind
children.answer_text: Start a return within 30 calendar days of delivery through Returns and Exchanges using your order number and the email address used at checkout. Select the items and choose a refund or an available size or color exchange. Items must be unused, unwashed, and in original condition with tags attached. Trying clothing on indoors is fine, but items with wear, stains, odors, or alterations are not eligible for a change-of-mind return. Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged for a change of mind or a different size, as shown on the product page and at checkout. If eligible, we email a prepaid USPS label and a QR code. Send the approved items within 14 calendar days of the label being issued, even if the original 30-day window ends during that period. For an ordinary refund return, $6 is deducted from your refund for each prepaid return label used. Place all approved items covered by the same label in one parcel, so the fee is per parcel rather than per item. Eligible size or color exchanges use a free return label. No printer is needed: pack the approved items, take the parcel and QR code to a participating USPS counter and ask the clerk to print the label, and keep the drop-off receipt. Contact support if the email or QR code is missing, if the label expires before you send it, or if you need portal help. Contact must be before the deadline and before using an expired label; a new label is not automatic.

children.label: Exchange for a different size or color
children.answer_text: You can exchange for a different available size or color of the same product within 30 calendar days of delivery through Returns and Exchanges. The original must be unused and unwashed with tags attached. The return label and standard shipping for the replacement are free. For a different product, return the original for a refund and place a new order. Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged for a change of mind or a different size. Replacement stock is not reserved when you request, we confirm availability after the original arrives and passes inspection. If the requested size or color has sold out, support will offer another available option or a refund to the original payment method, with no return label fee deducted if we cannot fulfill an approved exchange. We inspect the return and normally dispatch the available replacement within 3 business days after it reaches our warehouse, then it travels by standard shipping normally 3 to 5 business days after dispatch, and we email a new tracking link. If you need an item sooner, placing a separate order is the faster option, subject to stock availability.

children.label: Return or exchange a gift
children.answer_text: You can return or exchange a gift item under the same 30-day return window and condition requirements as a regular purchase. Use the gift receipt or ask support to locate the order. You can exchange for an available size or color of the same product, or receive a digital gift card for the amount originally paid. A gift return does not refund the purchaser's card. The ordinary $6 return label fee applies to a gift-card refund while eligible exchanges are free.

children.label: Report wrong or damaged item
children.answer_text: Contact support within 7 calendar days of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item, its label, and any damaged packaging. Do not pay for a return label yourself. Once we verify the problem, we arrange a replacement or refund and cover any required return shipping. This also applies to final-sale items.

children.label: Report suspected manufacturing defect
children.answer_text: Report a suspected manufacturing defect to support within 90 calendar days of delivery with your order number and photos for review. If it is confirmed as a manufacturing defect, we offer a replacement or refund and cover any required return shipping, including eligible defects on final-sale items. Normal wear, accidental damage, and damage caused by ignoring the care label are not covered.

children.label: Check refund or fix return problem
Check refund timing and status
children.answer_text: We inspect a refund return and issue an approved refund within 5 business days after the parcel reaches our warehouse. Use the return tracking link to confirm warehouse delivery, then look for a refund confirmation email as we email you when it is issued. Allow up to 5 business days after warehouse delivery for inspection and approval. If you received the refund email but cannot see the credit, allow your bank or card provider an additional 3 to 5 business days to show the credit. The return parcel's delivery scan starts the warehouse processing period, not the bank's posting period. Contact support when the applicable period has passed.

children.label: Check refund amount
children.answer_text: Your refund is based on the price actually paid for the returned item, including its share of any order-level discount and the applicable tax. An ordinary prepaid refund return has a $6 fee per label used. Original outbound shipping is not refunded for a change-of-mind return. We do not add a new outbound shipping charge if the remaining items fall below the free-shipping threshold.

children.label: Check where refund will go
children.answer_text: Refunds go to the original payment method and cannot be moved to a different card or bank account. If the original card has expired or been replaced, the card issuer normally routes the credit to the replacement account, contact your card issuer if you need help locating it. Gift-recipient returns are issued as a digital gift card instead. For an ordinary purchaser return paid with a gift card and a card, the approved refund goes back to the gift card first, up to the gift card amount used on the order, then any remaining approved refund goes to the original card. Neither payment method receives more than the amount it originally paid. The refund confirmation shows the allocation.

children.label: Report lost return parcel
children.answer_text: If you used our prepaid label, keep your USPS drop-off receipt and contact support when there has been no return tracking update for 5 business days. We will open a carrier investigation and review the proof of drop-off. A refund is not automatic while the parcel is missing. If you arranged your own shipping, contact that carrier and share the tracking details with us.

children.label: Sort out rejected return
children.answer_text: We email you with the reason and any relevant photos if an item is worn, washed, missing required tags, or otherwise outside the approved return conditions. Support will explain the available next steps before the case is closed. An inspection rejection does not automatically create a refund, and items are not automatically discarded without contacting you.

children.label: Check accepted payment methods
children.answer_text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and our digital gift cards. Available methods appear at checkout. All prices and payments are in US dollars. You can combine a digital gift card with one supported card or wallet payment to cover the remaining balance.

children.label: Understand pending charge or declined payment
children.answer_text: Your card is authorized when you order and collected when the items dispatch. Gift card funds are deducted at checkout. A pending authorization is not an extra completed charge. If your order ships in multiple parcels you may see separate completed charges that add up to the order total, you are not charged the full total again for each parcel. If checkout was declined you may still see a temporary authorization even though no order was completed, so check for an order confirmation before trying again. Your bank normally removes an unused authorization within 3 to 5 business days although timing can vary. If you have an order number or you see two completed charges contact support so we can check the order.

children.label: Use promo code before paying
children.answer_text: Use one promotion code per order and enter it before paying. Check its expiry date, minimum spend, and eligible items. Codes do not apply to final-sale items, gift cards, shipping, or tax, and they cannot be combined. The checkout message explains why a code is not eligible. Free standard shipping still uses the merchandise subtotal after discounts.

children.label: Buy or use digital gift card
children.answer_text: Digital gift cards are emailed to the recipient address entered at purchase after payment is approved, normally within 15 minutes. To use one, enter the gift card code at checkout for all or part of the balance. Gift cards do not expire and any unused balance stays on the same code. Delivered digital gift cards cannot be returned for a change of mind.

children.label: Sort out missing gift card email
children.answer_text: Check the recipient's spam folder and allow up to 15 minutes after payment approval. If it is still missing, contact support with the gift card order number and the purchaser's checkout email. After verifying the purchase, we can resend it or correct the recipient email. Do not post an unused gift card code in a public chat or review.

children.label: Request price adjustment
children.answer_text: Contact support with the order number if a full-price item drops to a regular sale price within 7 calendar days of your order date. We offer one price adjustment per item to the original payment method. This does not apply to final-sale purchases, promotion codes, flash promotions, or gift cards. After approval, a card credit may take an additional 3 to 5 business days to appear.

children.label: Pick clothing size
children.answer_text: Open the Size Guide on the individual product page and compare your body measurements with that item's chart. Most core clothing styles are available from XS to 3XL, but the product's available options are the final guide. Check the fit notes and model measurements as well. Size charts can differ between products, so do not rely only on a size bought in another style.

children.label: Choose between two sizes
children.answer_text: Use the product's fit notes to decide: a fitted cut usually feels closer to the body than a relaxed cut. If you prefer extra room, choose the larger of the two sizes unless the product page says otherwise. Support can compare the garment measurements with your preferred fit. An eligible unused item can be exchanged for another available size within 30 days of delivery.

children.label: Check petite and tall options
children.answer_text: Selected trousers and dresses have petite or tall length options. Check the individual product page for available lengths and inseam measurements. If a length is not listed, that version is not currently offered for that style. Support can help compare measurements, but we do not provide a tailoring or alteration service.

children.label: Get notified when size is back
children.answer_text: Select the unavailable size on the product page and use Notify Me if that option is offered. We email you when that exact size and color is available again. A notification does not reserve stock or guarantee a restock date. Limited collections and final-sale items may not be restocked.

children.label: Ask about color versus photos
children.answer_text: Check the written color name together with the product photos. We photograph items to represent color as closely as possible, but screen settings and lighting can make colors look different. If the color is not what you expected, an eligible unused item can be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery. If the item label shows a different color from the one ordered, contact support as a wrong-item issue.

children.label: Check how to wash garment
children.answer_text: Follow the care label attached to your specific garment, it takes priority over general care advice. Check the product page for fabric composition and care details. If the label and product page appear to disagree, contact support with the style name and a photo of the label before washing. Damage caused by ignoring the care label is not treated as a manufacturing defect.

children.label: Send order as gift
children.answer_text: You can add a gift message during checkout at no charge. Clothing is folded in tissue inside our normal protective packaging; a separate gift box is not offered. The parcel's packing slip does not show prices, while the purchaser receives the payment receipt by email. A gift receipt can be included for eligible gift returns and exchanges.

children.label: Find guest order or missing order
children.answer_text: Open Order Lookup with your order number and the email entered at checkout to manage your order. You do not need an account to place or manage an order. From there you can check status, track parcels, and use any cancellation or address-change options still available. Returns and Exchanges also accepts guest orders. If an order is in your email but not in your account, it may have been placed as a guest or with another email address, use the email and order number from the confirmation to access it. Creating a new account does not automatically import orders placed with a different email. Contact support if you want help linking a verified guest order to your account.

children.label: Reset account password
children.answer_text: Choose Forgot Password on the sign-in page and enter the email address on your account. The reset link is valid for 1 hour. If it does not arrive, check spam and confirm the spelling of the email. Requesting a new link replaces the previous one. Support will never ask you to send your password.

children.label: Change account email address
children.answer_text: Sign in, open Account Settings, and enter the new email address. Confirm the change using the verification message sent to the new address. Updating an account email does not change the email already attached to an existing order. Contact support if an order's contact email also needs to be corrected.

children.label: Get receipt or invoice
children.answer_text: Open the order in your account or Order Lookup and select Download Receipt. The receipt shows purchased items, discounts, tax, shipping, and the amount paid in US dollars. Dispatches and approved refunds are also listed when applicable. Contact support if the billing name on the document needs a correction.

children.label: Stop marketing emails
children.answer_text: Use Unsubscribe at the bottom of a marketing email or update Email Preferences in your account. It can take up to 2 business days for the change to apply. Order confirmations, dispatch messages, return instructions, and refund updates are still sent because they are needed to manage a purchase.

children.label: Contact support
children.answer_text: Use the website's live chat during support hours or email help@demo-apparel.example. For an existing order include the order number, checkout email and a short explanation of what happened, plus photos for a wrong, damaged or defective item. Do not send your password, full card number or card security code. Support is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern Time excluding US public holidays, normally replies to email within 1 business day, and messages outside hours are handled on the next business day. To follow up reply to the existing email conversation or quote the case number in live chat, avoid opening several tickets for the same order because it can split information, and tell us promptly if the situation changes such as a missing parcel arriving or a refund appearing. If you cannot use the return portal or online forms we can help locate an order, explain the options in plain text, or create an eligible return or exchange request on your behalf after verifying the order, with the same return deadlines and item conditions applying so contact us before the relevant deadline if you need assistance.
